newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate drops to 20.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi three-month T-Bill rate drops to 20.43 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped by 0.55 percent to 20.43 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 20.98 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Wednesday.
Applications for 268.05 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 118.44 million at the average price of 95.03 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped by 1.34 percent to 21.54 percent from 22.88 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 109.24 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 85.52 million kwacha at the average price of 90.05 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate also dropped by 1.68 percent to 20.37 from 22.05 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 76.69 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 56.69 kwacha at the average price of 85.19 kwacha percent.
